words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ where bidders may revoke their bids; the invited QA vendor has an active bid.
steps: The buyer sets the bid's status to revoke.
The vendor sends POST /v1/bids again on the same round.
words.expected: The app refuses the new bid (code 370: revocation is final within the event), and never with a server error.

act.say: The vendor revokes its own bid (the round allows revoking).
The same QA vendor opens a new bid on the round after its bid was revoked.
